Demo SMILES strings

Source: R/data.R
demo_smi.Rd

Character vector of example SMILES for demos and examples.

Usage

demo_smi

Format

A character vector of length 100.

Examples

head(demo_smi)
#> [1] "CC(=O)O[C@H]1CC[C@@H]2[C@@]1(CC[C@H]3[C@H]2CCC4=C3CCC(=O)C4)C"                                                                                      
#> [2] "CCNC(=O)CC[C@@H](C(=O)O)N"                                                                                                                          
#> [3] "C1=CC(=CN=C1)C(=O)OC[C@@H]2[C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]([C@H](O2)O)O)O)O"                                                                                     
#> [4] "CC1=C(/C(=C/C2=C(C(=C(N2)C(=O)C3=C(C(=C(N3)/C=C\\4/C(=C(C(=O)N4)C=C)C)C=C)C)C)CCC(=O)O)/NC1=O)CCC(=O)O"                                             
#> [5] "C/C(=C\\C=C\\C=C(\\C=C\\C=C(\\C(=O)O[C@@H]1O[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]1O)O)O)CO)/C)/C)/C=C/C=C(/C(=O)O[C@@H]2O[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]2O)O)O)CO)\\C"
#> [6] "C1C=CN(C=C1C(=O)N)[C@@H]2[C@@H]([C@@H]([C@H](O2)COP(=O)(O)OP(=O)(O)OC[C@@H]3[C@H]([C@H]([C@@H](O3)N4C=NC5=C(N=CN=C54)N)O)O)O)O"
